thread.title: Special Participation E: Warmup Worksheet for HW 1
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>I fed ChatGPT HW0 (pre-requisites), HW 1, and Discussion 1 and asked it to make a worksheet in the form of a homework to make me ready to do the homework. The warm-up worksheet included topic reviews and problems, to make me ready to solve the homework fully alone. I have added my trace here and the worksheets ChatGPT created - it has all necessary material and was quite detailed. </paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/UAQ93kJZr7f63KAZyPRSUdp3" filename="Homework 1 warm-up.pdf"/><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/2SSg5IwBnw4TrQlevdO4jpWQ" filename="hw1warmupsoln.pdf"/><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/ZywOjEGyFsLGBYclAlB5jtbH" filename="hw1warmup.pdf"/></document>
